After experiencing an unexpected divorce from a long marriage, she searched for answers to help her heal and to create the great love she has with her new husband today.
Her vision is for each one of YOU to have a great relationship,
whether it’s a partner, family member, friend, coworker, neighbor, etc. Sometimes, it isn’t easy, but with these tools, you really can create and sustain great relationships that last a lifetime.
Even though this is focused on partner relationships, the tools apply to all relationships. She’s used it in many situations, and you can too.
You’re invited to study it, practice the
with her guiding prompts and see the magic happen, one relationship at a time!
